title: Add Juggluco to BG source list
symptom: The issue requests that Juggluco be added to the BG source list in AAPS, as Juggluco imitates xDrip communications and can be used as a BG source if AAPS is set to xDrip.
fix: The fix was implemented by changing the xDrip source label and description to include Juggluco, as shown in the commit referenced by MilosKozak.
settings_changed: description_source_xdrip → Receive BG values as xDrip broadcast from xDrip+ or Juggluco.
